executive_summary:
The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration proposed standardized, cyan-colored marker lights for self-driving cars to signal autonomous driving capabilities, stating these lamps should be optional rather than mandatory [1](https://carbuzz.com/nhtsa-cyan-marker-lights-for-self-driving-cars/). The Federal Aviation Administration sent its final Part 108 rule to the White House Office of Information and Regulatory Affairs for review, which may allow drone operators to fly routinely beyond the operator’s line of sight without seeking individual approval for each operation [2](https://www.knobbe.com/blog/clearing-the-way-for-routine-drone-flights-why-the-faas-part-108-rule-raises-the-stakes-for-patent-strategy/).

Tesla announced its robotaxi service is “coming soon” to San Antonio, Jacksonville, Las Vegas, and Phoenix, while expanding its operating territory in six existing cities across Texas and Florida [3](https://www.expressnews.com/business/article/tesla-robotaxi-service-san-antonio-22495640.php). In Europe, Latvia and Slovakia endorsed Tesla’s Assisted Driving software, with Latvia becoming the tenth European nation to sanction the technology [4](https://www.rswebsols.com/news/is-teslas-launch-of-self-driving-technology-in-slovakia-premature/). Nuro Co-CEO Jiajun Zhu shared memos arguing that LiDAR and radar raise the safety ceiling over camera-only systems, distinguishing Level 4 driverless systems from Level 2 driver assistance [5](https://eletric-vehicles.com/nuro/nuro-co-ceo-renews-case-for-lidar-as-lucid-uber-robotaxi-nears/).

In Spain, a high-speed train slammed into the rear of another stopped train, derailing two cars and killing at least 30 people [6](https://www.myplainview.com/news/world/article/spanish-authorities-say-2-trains-have-been-22497897.php). The Royal Commission for Riyadh City awarded Siemens Mobility a contract for 27 four-car driverless trainsets and 52 cars for metro lines 1 and 2 [7](https://www.railwaygazette.com/urban/2026/10/28/urban-rail-industry-news-round-up-28/). The Asian Development Bank approved a US$302.38 million loan to modernize the Baku Metro [7](https://www.railwaygazette.com/urban/2026/10/28/urban-rail-industry-news-round-up-28/).

ANYbotics began customer deliveries of ANYmal X, a four-legged inspection robot designed for explosive environments, to customers including Equinor and DSM-Firmenich [8](https://theaiinsider.tech/2026/10/28/anybotics-begins-deliveries-of-quaduped-inspection-robots-for-explosive-industrial-environments/). XPeng Group revealed that the solid-state battery for its IRON robot has completed small-batch production, with large-scale production targeted by the end of 2026 [9](https://finance.biggo.com/news/1e8b6cea-51f2-4aaf-b6d0-fe02c09b3df3). LG Electronics will begin full-scale operation of a robot data factory in Seoul and expand mass-production preparations for actuators [10](https://biz.chosun.com/en/en-it/2026/10/28/F5GAJVWELRBJPPXXROHUL3ML6M/?outputType=amp).
what_to_watch: The investigation into the Toledo high-speed rail collision, including the cause of the rear-end impact and the suspension of the Madrid-Andalusia line.
NHTSA's finalization of the rulemaking for standardized cyan-colored lights to identify autonomous vehicles in traffic.
The rollout of Tesla's Assisted Driving (TAD) software in Latvia and Slovakia, including early operational feedback and regulatory adjustments.

UAS / Drones.title: Clearing the Way for Routine Drone Flights: Why the FAA’s Part 108 Rule Raises the Stakes for Patent Strategy | Knobbe Martens
UAS / Drones.summary: On July 10, 2026, the FAA sent its final Part 108 rule to the White House Office of Information and Regulatory Affairs for review. Once in effect, the rule may allow drone operators to fly routinely beyond the operator’s line of sight without seeking individual FAA approval for each operation.

Autonomous Vehicles.title: Why the government wants self-driving cars to glow cyan
Autonomous Vehicles.summary: A Waymo fully-autonomous Ojai robotaxi arrives to pick up passengers Thursday, Sept. 17, 2026. Waymo launched its fully-autonomous robotaxi service in Las Vegas on Sept. 14.

Autonomous Vehicles.title: Tesla’s Self-Driving Launch in Slovakia: Premature Move or Progress?
Autonomous Vehicles.summary: Latvia and Slovakia have recently joined the ranks of European nations endorsing Tesla’s Assisted Driving (TAD) software, with Latvia becoming the tenth European nation to sanction the technology this Monday. In Slovakia, resident Igor Marcek, 35, who purchased his Tesla two years prior, finds himself increasingly exhilarated by the prospects of TAD—formerly known as FSD.

Autonomous Vehicles.title: Nuro Co-CEO Renews Case for LiDAR as Lucid-Uber Robotaxi Nears
Autonomous Vehicles.summary: Nuro Co-CEO Jiajun Zhu shared four memos arguing that LiDAR and radar raise the safety ceiling over camera-only systems, and that Level 4 driverless systems are distinct products from Level 2 driver assistance.

Autonomous Vehicles.title: Korean taxis in LA — Waymo Robotaxis and Rising Gas Costs Crush Profits
Autonomous Vehicles.summary: Do-il Yoon, CEO of Hana Taxi, stated on October 27 that many Korean taxi operators have seen revenues drop by about 30% since the introduction of unmanned taxis. According to the American Automobile Association (AAA), gas prices in the Los Angeles area rose 31% from a year ago.

Autonomous Vehicles.title: Urban rail industry news round-up
Autonomous Vehicles.summary: The Royal Commission for Riyadh City awarded Siemens Mobility a contract for 27 four-car driverless trainsets and 52 cars for metro lines 1 and 2, while the Asian Development Bank approved a US$302·38m loan to modernize the Baku Metro.

Autonomous Vehicles.title: WeRide launches global insurance program with Allianz and Ping An to support autonomous vehicle expansion.
Autonomous Vehicles.summary: Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacífico (GAP) announced a dividend payment of 20.80 pesos per share, approved at its April 2026 shareholders' meeting. The dividend will be paid on November 6, 2026, to shareholders presenting coupon No. 42 of their share certificate.

Autonomous Vehicles.title: Tesla Robotaxi service ‘coming soon’ to San Antonio, other cities
Autonomous Vehicles.summary: Tesla Inc. announced its robotaxi service is “coming soon” to San Antonio, Jacksonville, Fla., Las Vegas, and Phoenix, while expanding its operating territory in six existing cities across Texas and Florida.

Autonomous Vehicles.title: America's About To Get New Color Marker Lights For Self-Driving Cars To Warn Other Drivers
Autonomous Vehicles.summary: The NHTSA proposes standardized, cyan-colored marker lights for self-driving cars to signal autonomous driving capabilities, with the agency stating these lamps should be optional as opposed to mandatory. These proposed updates target Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard No. 108 and include new equipment requirements for beam-switching, hazard lights, and turn signals.

Robotics.title: ANYbotics Begins Deliveries of Quaduped Inspection Robots for Explosive Industrial Environments
Robotics.summary: ANYbotics has begun customer deliveries of ANYmal X, a four-legged inspection robot designed to operate in explosive environments at oil, gas and chemical facilities. The Zurich-based robotics company announced the system is shipping to customers including Equinor and DSM-Firmenich.

Robotics.title: XPeng's IRON Robot Solid-State Battery Rolls Off in Small-Batch Production, Scale Manufacturing Targeted by Year-End
Robotics.summary: Gu Jie, vice president of XPeng Group, revealed on October 28 that the solid-state battery for the IRON robot has completed small-batch production, with large-scale production targeted by the end of 2026 and deliveries beginning in 2027.

Robotics.title: LG Electronics launches Korea robot data factory, expands actuator push
Robotics.summary: LG Electronics will begin full-scale operation of the robot data factory it built this fourth quarter in Umyeon-dong, Seocho-gu, Seoul. It will also expand mass-production preparations for actuators, a core robot component, and ramp up order-taking activities for global clients.

Robotics.title: Shanghai Names Physical AI Equipment a Priority as Smart Factory Demand Drives Scaled Robot Deployment
Robotics.summary: Shanghai's Municipal Commission of Economy and Informatization issued the "Shanghai Action Plan for Accelerating the Development of a New Generation of Smart Manufacturing," designating the "development and promotion of Physical AI equipment" as a key task. The plan supports innovative breakthroughs in humanoid robots, collaborative robots, and high-precision overload robots, using smart factory construction demand to drive large-scale application.

Robotics.title: Tesla begins humanoid production in California
Robotics.summary: Elon Musk said in an earnings call that customer shipments could be ready by next year as Tesla makes progress on its Optimus robotics line in Fremont. Tesla plans to leverage its Terafab facility in Texas to supply enough AI5 chips for Optimus, which will be integrated with the robot in April.

Robotics.title: GXO Extends Digit Humanoid Robot to North Carolina and Tennessee After 100,000-Tote Milestone
Robotics.summary: Agility Robotics announced Monday that GXO Logistics has signed a commercial agreement to deploy Digit humanoid robots at two additional U.S. facilities — one in Statesville, North Carolina, and one in Lebanon, Tennessee — with operations scheduled to begin in early 2027.

Advanced Rail / High-Speed Rail.title: At least 30 dead in crash between two trains in central Spain, media say
Advanced Rail / High-Speed Rail.summary: A high-speed train slammed into the rear of another train that had stopped, derailing two cars and killing at least 30 people on Wednesday in central Spain, according to local media.

Military UAS.title: Army tests autonomous robots that hunt enemy targets
Military UAS.summary: Four robotic vehicles were sent hunting for enemy targets during a military demonstration at Fort Knox, Kentucky, recently, but only one initially moved. The four experimental vehicles were developed under the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency's RACER program, which aims to give unmanned ground vehicles the ability to navigate difficult terrain without human drivers.

International Security.title: ZAWYA: Oman advances drone innovation programme across six key sectors — TradingView News
International Security.summary: Oman's Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology (MTCIT) and Civil Aviation Authority (CAA) have concluded the Expression of Interest (EOI) submission period for the Oman AAM Strategic Demonstrator Programme, which targets six priority sectors including air taxi services and healthcare. Shortlisted applicants are expected to be notified by November 15, ahead of live demonstrations planned for December 6–10 and a main showcase scheduled for December 8–9.
